This vignette illustrates the use of package `whereipm`, which allows to build spatial IPMs to model population dynamics in space (not 'in Space'!).

## Let's begin!

First of all, you'll need to install the package:
```{r, eval=FALSE}
install.packages('whereipm')
```

Or, if you already have it installed, just load it with:
```{r}
library(whereipm)
```


## Easy start: a purely theoretical model

This package allows building IPMs from scratch, manually deciding on which parameters are to be used to build the IPM kernel.

Also a quote using `>`:

> "He who gives up [code] safety for [code] speed deserves neither."
